hypothesis: Add two new FM fields derived from `hourmin` (hour-of-day bucket) and `date` (days-since-train-start bucket, quantized into e.g. 8-12 buckets) to the existing 5-field input, keeping FM's architecture/hyperparameters unchanged. Because train and valid are temporally separated, time-of-day and recency signals aren't captured by user_id/video_id/author_id/tab/dur_bucket alone, and these are the organisers' explicitly untested direction (#6) rather than 'more static features' (already shown dead: CWM item-metadata fields). Since hour/date are context features shared across users, they can only help via crosses with item-side ids (video freshness, author posting-time patterns) -- exactly the mechanism FM's pairwise interactions exploit. Expect primary to move by +0.003 to +0.006 over 0.6016 if temporal drift/time-of-day crosses carry real signal; if the gain is <0.002 this direction is exhausted and should be abandoned in favor of pairwise-loss work.
